name: set_current_work
title: Say what you are doing
description: Say what you are doing on your task's card now; the card shows it next to your name. Call it at the start of a multi-step stretch, in the same response as your next step; not at every step or for a short reply. Only the latest is kept, until your round ends.

summary.description: One declarative line in the project language, without your name, at most 80 characters, e.g. "The gateway tests are being written".

detail.description: More about it, at most 300 characters; only the task page shows it.
